verdict.rationale: Supabase's own full-text search guide says Postgres's built-in Full Text Search works as a 'search engine' within Postgres. It documents `to_tsvector`/`to_tsquery` usage, match operators and search-column indexing directly against the project database, so no external search service is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of client-library/REST API exposure of search and relevance ranking.
